meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: The rates of the week as the RBI's Weekly Statistical Supplement prints them since April 2011: policy rates, call money, T-bill and 10-year bond yields, and the deposit and lending rates banks advertise (term and savings deposit ranges, base rate, overnight MCLR)
meta.note: RBI, Weekly Statistical Supplement, Table 4 'Ratios and Rates' (DBIE report 10, the rates block, data provider DP6). Deposit and lending rates are ranges across major banks (low and high ends); a week printing one rate gives both ends that rate. The exchange-rate and forward-premia lines of the same table belong to the external-account guide; the credit-deposit ratios to the credit guide.
